2105-4460-4598-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4460-4598-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4460-4598-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2527-4076-4279-4549-7286.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2527-4076-4279-4549-7286.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

539-1491-6218-7741.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

628-6487-8095.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
An opponent controls seven or more creatures.
628-6487-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Canker Abomination.
When Canker Abomination dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
If the opponent had seven or more creatures, Canker Abomination will die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness. If this occurs, repeat steps 2 through 4 infinitely.
Otherwise, resolve the Hammerhead ability, and repeat from step 1.
Cast Canker Abomination by paying {2}{B/G}{B/G}.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
Canker Abomination dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2150-2281-4247.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Hero of the Dunes
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Hero of the Dunes
When Hero of the Dunes dies, Saffi triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

277-4094-4772-6441-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-4094-4772-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

851-4365-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3532-5078-5645-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5645-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

3492-3609-4112-7638.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Sharuum.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

2308-2811-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-2811-4871-5231.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Elas il-Kor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Elas il-Kor and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger from step 5, causing each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger from step 3, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4785-6753.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

630-2366-4885-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
630-2366-4885-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

567-2440-3399-4399.description:
Cast Stormfront Riders by paying {4}{W/P} due to Defiler of Faith.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Mana Echoes and Soul's Attendant triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders spell. When it enters, it, Mana Echoes and Soul's Attendant trigger.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders trigger, returning it and the Soldier token created in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders' second ability triggers twice.
Resolve a Stormfront Riders trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 10 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger from step 6, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Repeat.

4053-4336-5147-6989.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1395-4195-4211-4574.description:
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

862-5220-6797-6900.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

3394-3693-5220.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Weatherlight Compleated.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Walking Ballista from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, causing you to put a phyresis counter on it and draw a card, thus drawing Omarthis from your library.
Repeat.

4215-5630-6797-6872.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Moss-Pit Skeleton.
When Moss-Pit Skeleton dies, Long Feng and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Moss-Pit Skeleton and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1445-4871-5231-6351.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5231-6351.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1251-2105-3204-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1251-2105-3204-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

847-969-2440-2719.description:
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Sakashima.
Choose to have Sakashima enter the battlefield as a copy of Gilraen.
When Sakashima enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Human and/or Noble you control.
Activate Sakashima by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Gilraen.
When Gilraen enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Human and/or Noble you control.
Repeat.
If you control one additional Human and/or Noble, this combo will net infinite colorless mana.

2034-4926-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
2034-4926-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wingmantle Chaplain, adding {C}{C}.
Wingmantle Chaplain dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Wingmantle Chaplain from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Wingmantle Chaplain enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least two 1/1 Bird creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Bird, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

628-2193-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Chainbreaker.
When Chainbreaker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

228-643-678-1778-3626.description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Memnite.
Memnite dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Enduring Renewal and Skullclamp.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

129-1912-2713-3883-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {U}, causing an opponent to draw a card.
Hullbreacher replaces the card drawn with you creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it to add {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding a mana of any color.
Repeat.

813-1181-1893.description:
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Shallow Grave by paying {1}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Sacrifice and Shallow Grave from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1099-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sling-Gang Lieutenant, adding {C}{C}.
When Sling-Gang Lieutenant dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Sling-Gang Lieutenant from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Sling-Gang Lieutenant enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
1099-2034-5003.notes: The extra Goblin can be sacrificed to Sling-Gang Lieutenant for infinite lifegain and lifeloss.
